text: What feature would improve your workflow most? A Slack or Teams integration for status updates, we're tired of manual notifications.
The reporting/export tools feel basic compared to competitors. Custom date ranges and per-team breakdowns would be a big win.
Onboarding was confusing for my team, an interactive walkthrough for new users would reduce our ramp-up time significantly.
Security is our top concern, two-factor authentication is table stakes for tools handling our project data.
Mobile experience needs improvement, especially on Android where the app feels sluggish and drains battery faster than expected.
Would love push notifications for task assignments and due-date reminders on mobile, currently very easy to miss things.
Integrations are our biggest gap, specifically Zapier and Google Calendar sync would save our ops team hours every week.
Billing transparency could improve, it wasn't clear what we'd be charged after upgrading and support was slow to clarify.
Overall very happy with TaskFlow's core task management, no major complaints from our team this quarter.
A native Teams integration is the one thing blocking wider adoption at our company since leadership mandated Teams last year.
